arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Urbanski argued the state harmlessness determination was an adjudication on the merits.
She stated a federal court can set aside the state judgment only if specific conditions are met.
Mr. Dain agreed the state ruling was an adjudication on the merits.
He based this position on the harmlessness determination made by the state court.
